metadata.name: MTBS wildfire centroids
metadata.geography: United States, including Alaska and Hawaii
metadata.aggregation: One point per MTBS event typed as wildfire; coordinates rounded to 3 decimals.
caveats: Centroids are approximate locations, not fire perimeters.
Fire names are included only for events at or above 10,000 acres.
MTBS assesses fires a season or more after they burn; provisional years are marked separately.
